lines.japanese: 「この冬休みが明ければ、いよいよ皆さんも卒業を迎えることになります。たった二週間の休みではありますが、えー、各自の進路を見据えて、この時間を有意義に使うように」
lines.english: “When winter vacation ends, all of you will at last be approaching graduation. It may be only two weeks, but use the time meaningfully, with an eye toward the path each of you intends to take.”

lines.japanese: 「年末には田舎へ帰るひともいると思いますが、気の充実を図り、体の休養をしっかりとって、心身ともに万全の状態で新年を迎えてください」
lines.english: “Some of you will be going home to the country for New Year's. Replenish your spirits, give your bodies proper rest, and greet the new year in perfect health of mind and body.”

lines.japanese: 「委員長、号令を」
lines.english: “Class representative, call the class to order.”

lines.japanese: 「起立。着席。礼」
lines.english: “Stand. Sit. Bow.”

lines.japanese: 俺たちはスクワットを一回してから頭を下げた。
lines.english: We performed one squat, then bowed our heads.

lines.japanese: 終わった。美空学園での終業式が終わった。次の学期末が来たときは卒業だ。
lines.english: It was over. Misora Academy's closing ceremony was over. The next time a term ended, we would graduate.

lines.japanese: でも感慨深さみたいなものはない。つうか受験前のこの空気の中で浸ったり出来るほど俺は若くない。
lines.english: But I felt no deep emotion. Or rather, in this pre-exam atmosphere, I was too old to sit around wallowing in sentiment.

lines.japanese: 「羽田」
lines.english: “Haneda.”

lines.japanese: さらに若くないのが近づいてきた。肉体的にも精神的にも。
lines.english: Someone even less young approached me, physically and mentally alike.

lines.japanese: 「どうした長老」
lines.english: “What is it, Elder?”

lines.japanese: 「遊ぼうぜェ」
lines.english: “Let's play.”

lines.japanese: 「もはや意味が分からない」
lines.english: “At this point, I no longer understand what those words mean.”

lines.japanese: ハリュー・クロードは俺の前の席にどかんと尻を落とした。渡来といいこいつといい、持ち主に一度でいいから許可を取ってほしい。
lines.english: Haryu Claude dropped his ass heavily into the seat in front of mine. Between him and Watarai, I wished one of them would ask its owner for permission just once.

lines.japanese: 「おとといのおまえからさァ、なにか生んでくれそうな気配を感じたんだよ。俺なぁ、今日は宇宙人と戦いてえなあ」
lines.english: “There was something about you the day before yesterday. Felt like you might give birth to something. Me, I feel like fighting aliens today.”

lines.japanese: 「よし、火星へ行くんだ。いまなら土地代タダに近いぞ」
lines.english: “Excellent. Go to Mars. Land is practically free right now.”

lines.japanese: 「チッ、つまんねェやつ……ん、ンンッ！」
lines.english: “Tch. Boring bastard... Hm, hmmm!”

lines.japanese: ハリュー・クロードはぐいとミネラルウォーターを呷り、跳ねるように立ちあがった。
lines.english: Haryu Claude took a long pull of mineral water and sprang to his feet.

lines.japanese: 「ま、いいや。そんなら俺も暇じゃねえし。じゃあな、ファッキン委員長」
lines.english: “Whatever. I've got better things to do too. See you, fucking class rep.”

lines.japanese: 「おう、また来世紀」
lines.english: “Sure. See you next century.”

lines.japanese: お互いに手を上げて別れかけたが、ハリュー・クロードが首だけを俺の方に向けた。
lines.english: We raised a hand to each other and nearly parted, but Haryu Claude turned only his head back toward me.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、それとォ」
lines.english: “Oh, and one more thing.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「言いにくいんだがなァ──」
lines.english: “Hard to say this, but—”

lines.japanese: 「どうした。高内さんと結婚でもするのか」
lines.english: “What's wrong? Marrying Takanouchi?”

lines.japanese: 「──止めはしねェけど、恋愛は健全なものにしときなよ」
lines.english: “—I won't try to stop you. Just make sure the romance stays wholesome.”

lines.japanese: それだけ言いのこしてハリュー・クロードは教室から出ていった。
lines.english: Leaving only those words, Haryu Claude walked out of the classroom.

lines.japanese: エスプリの利いた反論が思いつかなかった俺は、小癪な彼と不甲斐ない自らに腹を立てたので、とりあえず目の前にあった誰かの机を縦に９０度回転させておいた（八つ当たり）。
lines.english: Unable to devise a sufficiently witty rejoinder, I became angry with his insolence and my own inadequacy. So I rotated the nearest person's desk ninety degrees onto its side. (Taking it out on somebody else.)

lines.japanese: ああ心がクサクサする。今年最後の登校だというのに、もっと晴れ晴れしくいきたいものだ。
lines.english: Ahh, my heart was all moldy. This was my last day at school for the year; I wanted to go out on a brighter note.

lines.japanese: そうだ、こういうときは少しでも早く家へ帰って、愛しい妹の顔を見よう。きっと「お兄ちゃ～ん」と甘い声で癒してくれるに違いない。
lines.english: Right. I should get home as soon as I could and see my darling sister. Surely a sweet, drawn-out “Big Brotherrr!” from her would set me right.

lines.japanese: 「ぱね田くーん」
lines.english: “Paneeeda.”

lines.japanese: 「なに甘ったれた声出してんだ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Don't use that syrupy voice on me. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.”

lines.japanese: 「今日で二学期終わりだね」
lines.english: “Second term ends today.”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　うん、そうだな。また来月……いや、来年か」
lines.english: “Hm? Yeah, I guess it does. See you next month... No, next year.”

lines.japanese: 両手で鞄をぶら下げながらにこにこ笑ってる。渡来明日香のお姫様みたいな顔でこんな風に声をかけられると、俺の中の５分の１は浮かれだす。おかげでクサクサしていた心も少しだけフサフサになった。
lines.english: She dangled her bag from both hands and smiled. When a girl with Asuka Watarai's princess face approached me that way, one fifth of me grew giddy. Thanks to her, my moldy mood regained a little fluff.

lines.japanese: 「やるな渡来。俺の中でいまおまえのポイント高いぞ」
lines.english: “Well done, Watarai. Your stock is high with me right now.”

lines.japanese: 「なにその上から目線。私の中のぱね田ポイント、だだ下がりだよね」
lines.english: “What's with the condescension? Your Paneda points are in free fall with me right now.”

lines.japanese: 「くっ、生意気な反応。見直して損した」
lines.english: “Ghk. What a cheeky response. That's what I get for thinking better of you.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ目を輝かせて喜べばいいのか？　ん？」
lines.english: “Would you prefer I light up and jump for joy? Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、それはきもいだろう」
lines.english: “Hahaha. That would be disgusting.”

lines.japanese: 「わあ、うれしーい」
lines.english: “Oh, I'm so happy.”

lines.japanese: 彼女は白々しい微笑んだ。しかし実際楽しそうではあった。
lines.english: She gave me a transparently false smile. She did look genuinely amused, though.

lines.japanese: 「うむ。して何用だ」
lines.english: “Indeed. And what business brings you before Us?”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Mm-hm.”

lines.japanese: 噛みあわない。俺は自分のたずね方が伽楼羅的だったかと反省した。テイク２。
lines.english: We were not connecting. I reflected that my phrasing might have been too Garuda-like. Take two.

lines.japanese: 「で、どうしたの？」
lines.english: “So, what's up?”

lines.japanese: 「うんうん」
lines.english: “Mm-hm, mm-hm.”

lines.japanese: やっぱり噛みあわない。無駄ににこにこ笑ってるだけだ。ああ、からかわれてんのか。
lines.english: Still no connection. She was only standing there grinning to no purpose. Ah. She was teasing me.

lines.japanese: 「悪い、用事ないなら帰る」
lines.english: “Sorry. If you don't need anything, I'm going home.”

lines.japanese: 「うむっ？」
lines.english: “Hmm?”

lines.japanese: 進もうとしたら、渡来の体がずいっと横へ動いて俺の行方をさえぎった。
lines.english: When I tried to move, Watarai slid sideways and blocked my path.

lines.japanese: にこにこ笑ってる。
lines.english: She kept smiling.

lines.japanese: 「あのなあ、おまえ……」
lines.english: “Listen, you...”

lines.japanese: 「うりゃっ」
lines.english: “Hya!”

lines.japanese: 「そこをどけっ」
lines.english: “Move.”

lines.japanese: 「てりゃっ」
lines.english: “Terya!”

lines.japanese: 左右のどっちに足を進めようとしても遮られた。これじゃ帰れやしな──
lines.english: Whichever way I tried to step, she blocked me. At this rate, I would never get home—

lines.japanese: ──もしかして一緒に帰りたいんだろうか。
lines.english: —Could it be that she wanted us to walk home together?

lines.japanese: なのに自分からは誘いたくないとか、相変わらず子供みたいな発想してるんだろうか。
lines.english: Was she still thinking like a child, unwilling to be the one who asked?

lines.japanese: 「あのさ」
lines.english: “Listen.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Mm-hm.”

lines.japanese: 面倒だが、俺の中の５分の１に免じて折れてあげることにした。
lines.english: It was a nuisance, but for the sake of the one fifth inside me, I decided to yield.

lines.japanese: 「一緒に帰らない？」
lines.english: “Want to walk home together?”

lines.japanese: 「うんっ」
lines.english: “Mm-hm!”

lines.japanese: 彼女の満足そうな笑顔が、意外というか当然というか伊達にプリンセスと呼ばれてねえな、な感じだったので俺はおおむね、まあいいかな気分に落ちついた。
lines.english: Her satisfied smile was surprising and inevitable at once—the sort that said she was not called Princess for nothing. It left me feeling that, on balance, this was probably fine.

lines.japanese: 「どったの？　行こうよ」
lines.english: “What's wrong? Let's go.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はいはい」
lines.english: “Oh. Right, right.”

lines.japanese: 俺は渡来明日香を連れて校門をくぐった。このお姫様は歩いているだけで目立つので、一緒に歩いている俺まで視線を集めてしまう。
lines.english: I went through the school gates with Asuka Watarai. This princess stood out just by walking, so even I drew stares just for being beside her.

lines.japanese: 認めたくはないが、多少の含羞と優越感はあった。
lines.english: I hated to admit it, but there was a measure of bashfulness in me, and of superiority too.

lines.japanese: 「あのさ、ぱね田くん」
lines.english: “Hey, Paneda.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだい、わちゃらいさん」
lines.english: “What is it, Wachalai?”

lines.japanese: 「茶ぁしばこうぜ」
lines.english: “Let's go grab some tea.”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい、寄り道するなって先生に怒られちゃうだろ」
lines.english: “Come on. The teacher will scold us for making a detour.”

lines.japanese: 「せっかく推薦決まって自由な時間ができたのに、誰も遊んでくれないんだよう」
lines.english: “I finally got free time now that my recommendation is settled, but nobody will play with me.”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃあみんな受験生だからな。はっ、そうだ！　俺も受験生だから、こんなところで渡来明日香とのんびり歩いてる暇はないんだった」
lines.english: “Everyone else has entrance exams. Oh! Right! I'm taking entrance exams too. I don't have time to stroll around with Asuka Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「ぱね田くんは成績いいんでしょ？」
lines.english: “But your grades are good, aren't they, Paneda?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、それとも羽田君とは違うのかな」
lines.english: “Oh. Or is that only true of Haneda?”

lines.japanese: 「だから俺は羽田だと言ってるだろうガハハ足くせー」
lines.english: “I keep telling you, I am Haneda. Gah-hah-hah, your feet stink.”

lines.japanese: もう何度も繰りかえしたこのやり取り。もはやこれがなくては渡来明日香と話してる気がしないかもしれない。
lines.english: We had repeated this exchange countless times. Perhaps it no longer felt like a conversation with Asuka Watarai unless we performed it.

lines.japanese: 「でもさーあ」
lines.english: “Still...”

lines.japanese: 「なんですかーあ」
lines.english: “Still what?”

lines.japanese: 「最近ぱね田と話すのも楽しいかなって」
lines.english: “Lately I've been thinking talking to Paneda might actually be kind of fun.”

lines.japanese: 「だから……」
lines.english: “I keep telling you—”

lines.japanese: 俺こそが羽田だと言ってるのに、いい加減しつこい女だな。俺の中にはおまえのタカシ君だって含まれてるんだから、いつまでも羽田羽田いってないで、ちょっとはぱね田のことを認めてくれても──
lines.english: I was Haneda. What a stubborn woman. Her Takashi was included in me too, so she ought to stop going on and on about Haneda and acknowledge Paneda at least a little—

lines.japanese: 「──ん？　あれ？　渡来明日香、いまヘンなこと言わなかった？」
lines.english: “—Hm? Wait. Asuka Watarai, didn't you just say something strange?”

lines.japanese: しかし彼女は俺の質問を無視した。
lines.english: But she ignored my question.

lines.japanese: 「これからも仲良くしようよ」
lines.english: “Let's keep getting along.”
“O-okay...”

lines.japanese: これからも？　え、いままで仲良くしてたっけ？　なに突然、なんか企んでるのか？
lines.english: Keep getting along? Had we been getting along before? Why say this out of nowhere? Was she plotting something?

lines.japanese: しかし休戦協定ということなら悪くない申し出だ。しばらく様子を見てたけど、実際のとこ渡来明日香はさほど危険人物でもなかったしな。
lines.english: Still, if this was an offer of a truce, it was not a bad one. I had watched her for a while, and Asuka Watarai was not actually all that dangerous.

lines.japanese: というか、むしろ面白いやつだ。そして俺はいつでも友達募集中なのだ。
lines.english: If anything, she was entertaining. And I was always accepting applications for friends.

lines.japanese: 「とりあえず初詣は深夜にみんなで行こうよ」
lines.english: “First, let's all go make our New Year's shrine visit in the middle of the night.”

lines.japanese: 「みんなとか、あんまり友達いないくせに見栄を張るな」
lines.english: “Don't show off by saying ‘all’ when you barely have any friends.”

lines.japanese: 「除夜の鐘とか２００回くらい鳴らそう」
lines.english: “We can ring the New Year's Eve bell about two hundred times.”

lines.japanese: 「おお、いいぞ渡来明日香。素晴らしい、さすが賽銭を５０円以上入れる女は言うことが違うな。マーベラスだ」
lines.english: “Oh, excellent, Asuka Watarai. Splendid. A woman who puts at least fifty yen in the offering box thinks on a grand scale. Marvelous.”

lines.japanese: 楽しそうだ。考えるだけで胸が躍った。
lines.english: It sounded fun. My heart danced at the thought.

lines.japanese: 「あと甘酒一升瓶で一気飲みしたり、あはは」
lines.english: “And chug a whole 1.8-liter bottle of sweet rice drink. Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ……楽しそうだな……」
lines.english: “Yes... That sounds fun...”

lines.japanese: 頭の中がざわついてきた。体が疼くのを押さえきれない。わくわくする。
lines.english: A restless murmur rose inside my head. I could not contain the tingling in my body. I was excited.

lines.japanese: 異常なくらい……わくわくする……。
lines.english: Abnormally... excited...

lines.japanese: 「もちろんやるのはぱね田くんだけど……ぱね田くん？」
lines.english: “Of course, Paneda will be the one doing it... Paneda?”

lines.japanese: 「んー？　なーにー？」
lines.english: “Hmm? Whaaat?”

lines.japanese: 「どしたの？　顔がにやついてるよ、こわいこわい」
lines.english: “What's wrong? You're grinning. Scary, scary.”

lines.japanese: 「うひっ、だ、だってたのしそうじゃんかあ」
lines.english: “Uhee! B-because it sounds like so much fun.”

lines.japanese: やばい。
lines.english: This was bad.

lines.japanese: 「あはは、乗り気になってる。さすがはぱね田くんだよね」
lines.english: “Ahaha. Now you're getting into it. That's Paneda for you.”

lines.japanese: 「お、おれスッゲーわくわくしてきたんだも」
lines.english: “I-I'm gettin' real excited!”

lines.japanese: やばいやばいやばい。
lines.english: Bad, bad, bad.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ今からドーナツでも食べて計画練ろうよ」
lines.english: “Then let's go eat doughnuts and plan it out.”

lines.japanese: 「け、けいかく……」
lines.english: “P-plan...”
“Wait!”

lines.japanese: 落ちつけ！
lines.english: Calm down!

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「ど、どしたの？　なんかぱね田くん恐いよ？」
lines.english: “Wh-what's wrong? You're acting scary, Paneda.”

lines.japanese: やばい。最近少しでも楽しそうなことを見つけると、落ちつかなくなる。
lines.english: This was bad. Lately, the moment I found anything that sounded even slightly fun, I became restless.

lines.japanese: しかもここ数日で、数回の幼児化を起こしてしまった。
lines.english: And over the past few days, I had regressed into childhood several times.

lines.japanese: 「わ、悪い、今日は帰る。あとで電話でもする」
lines.english: “S-sorry. I'm going home today. I'll call you later.”

lines.japanese: 「…………ほぅ、どうしちゃったのかな」
lines.english: “............Oh? What brought this on?”

lines.japanese: 渡来明日香の顔が紅潮してるのが分かったが、今はそんなことを気にしている余裕もなかった。
lines.english: I could see Asuka Watarai's face flush, but I had no room to concern myself with that now.

lines.japanese: 「そっか。うんそれじゃまたね、バイバイ」
lines.english: “I see. All right, then. See you later. Bye-bye.”

lines.japanese: 「おうっ！　じゃあまたな！」
lines.english: “Yeah! See you!”

lines.japanese: 俺は元気よく手を振って駆けだした。
lines.english: I waved energetically and ran.

lines.japanese: 明日から冬休み。それをラッキーだと受けとることにした。
lines.english: Winter vacation began tomorrow. I decided to count that as a stroke of luck.

lines.japanese: 帰ってくる頃にはすっかり夕暮れ時だった。ここのところ、本当に陽が沈むのが早い。
lines.english: By the time I got home, evening had settled in completely. The sun really had been setting early lately.

lines.japanese: あークソ、まだ少し意識の浮いたような感覚が残ってる。
lines.english: Damn it. I could still feel my consciousness floating slightly loose.

lines.japanese: まず頭を落ちつかせないと。部屋に戻って少し休もう。
lines.english: I needed to calm my head first. I would go to my room and rest.

lines.japanese: 腹も減ったので台所から煎餅を何枚か持ちだして二階に上がった。
lines.english: I was hungry too, so I took several rice crackers from the kitchen and went upstairs.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、帰ってきてたのー？」
lines.english: “Big Brother, were you home?”
“Oh.”

lines.japanese: 煎餅をばりばり齧っていたら、小鳩の部屋から声が聞こえた。
lines.english: As I crunched noisily into a cracker, Kobato called from her room.

lines.japanese: そうだ、小鳩に癒してもらおう。あの天使のような微笑をみたら、この浮ついた気持ちがすっきりするかもしれない。
lines.english: Right. I would let Kobato soothe me. Perhaps the sight of her angelic smile would clear away this flighty feeling.

lines.japanese: 「おにいちゃん？」
lines.english: “Big Brother?”

lines.japanese: 「やあ、今帰ったよ。それより聞いてくれ小鳩、お兄ちゃん学校で困ったことがあって、それで煎餅……」
lines.english: “Hello. I just got back. More important, listen, Kobato. Big Brother had a problem at school, and then the rice crackers...”

lines.japanese: 俺は口に咥えていた煎餅をばりんと噛み砕いた。
lines.english: I bit through the cracker clenched between my teeth with a sharp crunch.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、そっかあ、小鳩もうかえってる時間かあ！」
lines.english: “Oh! Right! Kobato’s already home!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、お兄ちゃんもいまかえってきたの。分かる？」
lines.english: “Big Brother just got home too. Understand?”

lines.japanese: 「しめて」
lines.english: “Close it.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、なんのこと？　それよりポッポ、煎餅食べる？　これおいしいからぁ」
lines.english: “Huh? Close what? More important, Poppo, want a rice cracker? These're really good.”

lines.japanese: 「いいから、しめてようっ」
lines.english: “I don't care! Close it!”

lines.japanese: 「いいからってないでしょーう、お兄ちゃんたらポッポのこと心配してゆってんのに、もーう」
lines.english: “You shouldn’t say you don’t care. Big Brother’s worried about Poppo, and this is how you act? Honestly.”

lines.japanese: 「ふぇっ……」
lines.english: “Hweh...”

lines.japanese: 「あっ！　な、泣くなようポッポ！　泣くのはずるいでしょ、泣いたらなんでも勝ちじゃんか。だから泣くなって」
lines.english: “Oh! D-don't cry, Poppo! Crying's cheating. Once you cry, you win everything. So don't cry.”

lines.japanese: 「ふえっ、ふええ……」
lines.english: “Hweh... Hweeeh...”

lines.japanese: 「ポッポ泣くなって！　お兄ちゃんほら、プラモデル作ったの見せてやっから！　ほらほらこれ面白えぞー、必殺鼻毛マー……」
lines.english: “Poppo, don’t cry! Look, Big Brother’ll show you the model he made! Look at this, it’s great—the deadly Nose-Hair Ma—”

lines.japanese: <8>\「ふえええええーん！　おにいちゃんのばかあああああ！！」
lines.english: “Waaaaaaaaah! Big Brother, you idiooooooot!”

lines.japanese: <8>\「うわあああ、ごめんなさあーあい！」
lines.english: “Waaaaah! I'm sorrrrrry!”

lines.japanese: 「はあっ、はあ……」
lines.english: “Hah... hah...”

lines.japanese: あーあ、おれまーたポッポのこと泣かしちったよ。ポッポ昔からすぐ泣くんだもん、女は泣けばすーぐ許してもらえんだ。きったねえの。
lines.english: Aw, man. I made Poppo cry again. She'd always cried at the drop of a hat. Girls cry and everybody forgives 'em right away. It's cheating.

lines.japanese: だってポッポだってきがえてんのに声かけるのがわるいんだよ。そんなんおれだって入っていいと思うもん。おれ悪くないもんね。だからポッポはおれにもっとパンツ見せてくれてもいいはずなんだ。
lines.english: Besides, Poppo's the one who called me while she was changing. Course I'd think I could come in. Wasn't my fault. So Poppo oughta let me see her panties a little more.

lines.japanese: なのにおれがしゃべってるとちゅうでポッポのやつ泣いちゃったからパンツ全ぜん見られなかった。おれそれがくやしくてなんかうびゃー！ってなった。
lines.english: But Poppo started crying while I was still talking, so I didn't get to see her panties at all. That got me so mad something inside me went waaah!

lines.japanese: なんかおれモヤモヤしてっから、すんげーあばれたいーくて、りょう手ブンブンふり回して、足もジタバタさせた。マッカチンみたく、じったんばったんあばれまくった。
lines.english: I felt all tangled up and wanted to go completely wild, so I windmilled both arms and kicked both legs. I thrashed all over the place like a furious crayfish.

lines.japanese: 「あっびゃんびがびがばばばーん！　ぼりきゃーぶがんばぼぼびにー！　ぶるっきゃおう・ぴらむに！」
lines.english: “Abbyan-bigga-bigga-ba-ba-bam! Borikya-bugan-babobini! Brukkya-oh, piramuni!”

lines.japanese: ふうー、りょう手ふり回したらちょっとだけすっきりした。つかれちったけど、それくらいしないとモヤモヤがすげーヤだったから別にいいや。
lines.english: Phew. Swinging both arms around made me feel a little better. Tired me out, but the tangled feeling was so awful I didn't care.

lines.japanese: はー、すっきりした。そんですっきりしたのはいいけど、おれなにしてたんだっけ。
lines.english: Ahh. Better. Great, except what was I doing again?

lines.japanese: ていうかここどこだっけ？　ああそーだ、イーグルのへやだいねー。
lines.english: And where was I? Oh, right. Eagle's room.

lines.japanese: ハァハァゆいながらキョロキョロしたら、なんかチャリンコみたいなのあった。ハァハァゆってつかれてたけど、おもしろそうだからとびのって思いきしこいだ。
lines.english: Panting, I looked all around and found something like a bicycle. I was tired from all that panting, but it looked fun, so I jumped on and pedaled as hard as I could.

lines.japanese: シャカシャカシャカシャカシャカ！！
lines.english: Whir-whir-whir-whir-whir!

lines.japanese: 「はーっ！　はーっ！」
lines.english: “Hah! Hah!”

lines.japanese: じてんしゃのペダルこぐのってスゲー楽しかった。んでもおれ、もうマックスつかれたから、ゆかにゴロンてなった。そしたらこんどはゲームあんの見つけちった。
lines.english: Pedaling the bike was so much fun. But now I was max tired, so I flopped onto the floor. Then I found a game console.

lines.japanese: 「ああー、これゲームできんじゃん！　そーだおれウイングクエストすんっげー好きなんだよ。カセットどっかにないかなあ」
lines.english: “Oh! You can play games on this! Right, I love *Wing Quest*. Wonder if the cartridge's around here.”

lines.japanese: きょろきょろ見たけど、音がくのＣＤしかおいてないから超がっかりした。このＣＤぜんぶ売ってカセット買ってこよっかな。なんか久しぶりにウイングクエスト超やりてえ。
lines.english: I looked all around, but there were only music CDs. Huge disappointment. Maybe I'd sell 'em all and buy the cartridge. I really, really wanted to play *Wing Quest* again.

lines.japanese: なんか他に売るもんないか、さがしまくった。本とか売ってもやすいから別にいらない。もっと高く売れんのないかな。
lines.english: I searched everywhere for other stuff to sell. Books sell cheap, so forget those. Wasn't there anything worth more?

lines.japanese: 「おーっ、こっちのやつフリファじゃん！」
lines.english: “Oh! This one’s the Frickies!”

lines.japanese: これ、おれも好きだけど、お母さんもっとスッゲー好きで『ほほえみジェノサイド』とか超いいうた。
lines.english: I like 'em too, but Mom liked 'em way more. *Smiling Genocide* is a really great song.

lines.japanese: だからさわろうとした。
lines.english: So I tried to touch it.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん！」
lines.english: “Big brother!”

lines.japanese: 「あっ！」
lines.english: “Ah!”

lines.japanese: そしたらそのとちゅうでポッポが入ってきた。おれなんも悪いことしてないのにビックリしちって、あわてて手ぇ引っこめた。
lines.english: Then Poppo came in before I could. I hadn't done anything bad, but she startled me, so I snatched my hand back.

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめんねお兄ちゃん。さっきはビックリしちゃって……」
lines.english: “I-I’m sorry, big brother. You surprised me before, so...”

lines.japanese: 「あ！　そうだよ、もーう！　ポッポはお兄ちゃんばっか悪モンにして、ダメでしょーお」
lines.english: “Oh! Right! Honestly, Poppo! You made your brother out to be the bad guy. You shouldn't do that.”

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめんね」
lines.english: “I-I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: ポッポがあやまってくれたから、ちっとすっきりした。でもなんかオドオドしてぎょうぎ正しいから、おれはちょっとさみしくなった。
lines.english: Poppo apologized, so I felt a little better. But she was acting all nervous and polite, and that made me kinda lonely.

lines.japanese: 「うんー。でもそんなにはおこってないから、んーな顔しなくてもいいよ。おれポッポのこと本気でおこったりはしねーもん。だってお兄ちゃんじゃんか」
lines.english: “Okay. But I'm not that mad, so you don't hafta look like that. I'd never get really mad at Poppo. I'm your big brother.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、ありがと……えっ？」
lines.english: “Okay. Thank you... What?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、お兄ちゃん……？　もしかして……」
lines.english: “Um, big brother...? Could it be...?”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　なにー？」
lines.english: “Hm? What?”

lines.japanese: 「ま、また子供になっちゃったの？」
lines.english: “D-did you turn into a child again?”

lines.japanese: 「こ、こども……！」
lines.english: “A-a child...!”

lines.japanese: そーだ、おれこどもじゃないんだっけ……あれ？　だったら今のおれなんなの？　なんだかあたまのずつうがスッゲーいたくなってズキズキした。
lines.english: Right. I wasn’t a kid... Wait. Then what was I now? My head started hurting so bad it throbbed and throbbed.

lines.japanese: 「う、ううっ……」
lines.english: “U-ugh...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ご、ごめん！　大丈夫？」
lines.english: “Oh! S-sorry! Are you all right?”

lines.japanese: 「へ、ヘンなこと言うなよ、もうー。あたま、ズッキンズキンしちゃったでしょー」
lines.english: “D-don't say weird stuff. Now my head's pounding 'cause of you.”
“O-okay...”

lines.japanese: またポッポががっかりしちゃったけど、今はおれもアタマいたかったから、それどこじゃなかった。おれなんかむねがきゅーってなって泣きそうだった。
lines.english: Poppo looked sad again, but my head hurt too much to worry about that now. Something squeezed tight in my chest, and I felt like crying.

lines.japanese: 「もーう、ポッポはこんどそんなイジワルなことゆったらぜっこうだかんね！　口きーてやんないから！」
lines.english: “Honestly, Poppo! Say something that mean again and I won’t be your friend anymore! I won’t talk to you!”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんなあ……お兄ちゃんひどいよ」
lines.english: “N-no... Big brother, that’s awful.”

lines.japanese: 「やーですぅ！　ポッポは１００万べんあやまるまでゆるさないもんね！」
lines.english: “Too bad! I won't forgive Poppo till she says sorry a million times!”

lines.japanese: ほんとはゆるしてあげるつもりだったけど、あたまがいたいからそんくらいゆってやった。でも一回でもあやまったらすぐにゆるしてあげることにした。
lines.english: I really meant to forgive her, but my head hurt, so I said that much. Still, I decided I'd forgive her the very first time she apologized.

lines.japanese: 「ごめん、ほんとにごめんなさい。何でもするから許してよー」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. I'm really sorry. I'll do anything, so please forgive me.”
“What?!”

lines.japanese: なんでも？　いまなんでもって言った？
lines.english: Anything? Did she just say anything?

lines.japanese: 「ど、どーしよっかなあ～」
lines.english: “W-well, I wonder what I'll do...”

lines.japanese: おれほんとはもうおこってなかったけど、ポッポがなんでもって言うからちょっとゆるしてあげるのをやめた。
lines.english: I wasn't really mad anymore, but when Poppo said anything, I decided to wait a little before forgiving her.

lines.japanese: 「なんでもってどんなこと？　死ねって言ったら死ぬの？」
lines.english: “Whaddaya mean, anything? If I told you to die, would you die?”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そういうのはムリだけど……」
lines.english: “I-I can't do something like that...”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあなんでもじゃないじゃん！　ポッポのウソつきーい！」
lines.english: “Then it's not anything! Poppo, you liar!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、じゃあお兄ちゃん、私に死んでほしいのっ？」
lines.english: “Th-then, Big Brother, do you want me to die?”

lines.japanese: おれはちょっと困った。もしおれがポッポに死ねってゆって、ほんとに死んじゃったら、おれすごくかなしい。
lines.english: That put me in a bind. If I told Poppo to die and she really did, I'd be real sad.

lines.japanese: 「な、なにゆってんのもぉー。今のはかるいじょうだんだって、死ねなんていうわけないでしょー」
lines.english: “W-what're you saying? That was just a little joke. Course I wouldn't tell you to die.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、でもおれまだゆるしてないよ！　いいの？　そんなことゆったら、おれゆるしてあげないかもしんないよ？」
lines.english: “Oh! But I still haven't forgiven you! You sure about that? Say stuff like that and maybe I won't forgive you at all.”

lines.japanese: よかった、あやうく「なんでも言うこときいてくれるけん」をなくしちゃうとこだった。おれはあたまをフル回てんさせて、ポッポにしてほしいことを考えた。
lines.english: Good. I'd almost lost my do-anything-I-say coupon. I spun my brain at full speed and thought about what I wanted Poppo to do.

lines.japanese: でもよく考えなくても、ほんとはしてほしいこと決まってたんだ。へへへ。じつはさっきから、このまえのことばっか考えてた。
lines.english: But I didn't hafta think hard. I already knew. Heh-heh. I'd been thinking about what happened before this whole time.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあポッポ、ちょっとうしろむいてよ」
lines.english: “Okay, Poppo. Turn around for a second.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　うしろ？」
lines.english: “What? Turn around?”
